title: Canonical coherent-etale comparison respects structural pullback
statement: Let X and Y be proper over fields and j:Y -> X any scheme morphism. An etale coefficient map u from inverse image of the lifted tensor-section structure sheaf of X to that of Y is specified by its adjoint being structural pullback under tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit. Then the canonical coherent-etale comparisons [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison] intertwine H(u) composed with etale cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and moduleCohomologyFMap j applied to the structural coefficient map. This only compares pullback maps; it asserts no base-change isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose finite affine covers of X and Y, refining the cover on Y to subordinate it to inverse images of the cover on X. Separatedness makes tuples affine. The module, abelian and etale vanishing comparisons supply acyclic edges on both schemes.

As in the normalized power square, the site-change comparison agrees with the normalized family by degree-zero normalization, coefficient naturality and connecting-map compatibility. Its module/abelian side agrees with the fixed comparison by resolution normalization.

The adjoint formula for u identifies the etale refinement cochain map with structural pullback of regular functions. The ringed-site refinement square computes module fmap by the same map. Coefficient transport and the fixed Ext edge identify its presentation. Cancel the invertible Cech edges to prove equality on every class.

theorem coherentEtaleComparison_pullback
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsProper g] (j : Y ⟶ X) (q : ℕ)
    (u : (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} j).obj
      (structureTensorEtaleSheaf X) ⟶ structureTensorEtaleSheaf Y)
    (hu : ∀ (U : X.Etale) (s : (structureTensorEtaleSheaf X).obj.obj (op U)),
      (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ j).obj U).hom).app ⊤
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} j).homEquiv
          (structureTensorEtaleSheaf X) (structureTensorEtaleSheaf Y) u).hom.app
            (op U) s).down =
        (pullback.fst U.hom j).appTop
          ((tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit U.hom).app ⊤ s.down))
    (x : Sheaf.H (structureTensorEtaleSheaf X) q) :
    structureCoherentEtaleComparison g q
        (Sheaf.H.map u q (Etale.cohomologyMap j (structureTensorEtaleSheaf X) q x)) =
      (moduleCohomologyFMap j
        (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit j.toRingCatSheafHom) q).hom
        (structureCoherentEtaleComparison f q x)
